title: tracker digest --json
description: Each project's digest (DESIGN.md §2.6): what was auto-verified, and every shelve, human action and trigger-switching edit, since the project's digest was last acknowledged.

project.description: The one project covered, or null for every project: outside every root, or with --all.

digests.description: One digest per project covered, sorted by key.

acknowledged.description: When digest ack last recorded this project's digest as seen, or null if it never has. Everything listed is from after it.

verified.description: Every item auto-verified since the ack, the ones that passed on a judge first, then by when they were verified.

judged.description: Whether a judge passed it, rather than only scripts: its record has a judge answer.

criteria.description: Each criterion's text, numbered from 1 by position.

actions.description: Since the ack, oldest first: every shelve, approve, reject, criterion accept and delete, and every edit that removed needs-review or changed kind away from capability.

interactive.description: Whether it came from an interactive terminal. A human action not from one, or a shelve from one, needs a closer look (DESIGN.md §2.6).

reason.description: The reason given to a shelve or a reject.

status.description: For a delete, the state the item was in.

judged.description: For a shelve, true when the item has a judge criterion: starting it again empties its T11 count (DESIGN.md §7). Left out otherwise.

labels_removed.description: For an edit, the labels it removed.

kind_before.description: For an edit that changed the kind, the kind it replaced.

held_questions.description: For an approve or a reject, the judge questions it decided: each disputed fail with the model's and the agent's reasons, and each T10 answer.
